commands: git archive $(git merge-base HEAD main) | tar -x -C $TMPDIR/src-base; git archive HEAD | tar -x -C $TMPDIR/src-head
cd $TMPDIR/src-base && SCCACHE_BIN=/nonexistent CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/overhead-cold-base2 cargo build --release --locked -p celeris --bin celeris  # wall secs by date +%s%N
cd $TMPDIR/src-head && SCCACHE_BIN=/nonexistent CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$CARGO_TARGET_DIR/overhead-cold-head cargo build --release --locked -p celeris --bin celeris
cargo build --release --locked -p celerisctl --bin celerisctl  # same target subdir, after the timed build (reference size)
cargo build --release --locked -p celeris-script --bin script-bench  # head target subdir
cd control-ts && corepack pnpm@12.6.0 install --offline --frozen-lockfile && corepack pnpm@12.6.0 run typecheck && corepack pnpm@12.6.0 run bundle
<head target>/release/script-bench --bundle-dir control-ts/dist --iters 1000 --out $TMPDIR/bench{1,2,3}.json  # 3 runs, max of each field
cargo tree --locked -e normal -p task-dispatch -i deno_core; cargo tree --locked -e normal -p task-api -i deno_core  # both: did not match any packages
cargo tree --locked -p task-dispatch | grep -cE 'deno_core|\bv8\b|serde_v8'; same for task-api  # both 0
